name: spillwave-ui-guard
description: Wireframe-first + adversarial UI review enforcement. Bundle reusable UI Guard skills, a critic agent, and always-on rules.

interface.longDescription: Forces every meaningful UI change to start with a wireframe and spec, then requires a separate critic agent to launch the app and judge the running UI against acceptance criteria before the work is accepted.
defaultPrompt: Use Spillwave UI Guard to create or update a wireframe before any UI implementation.
Use Spillwave UI Guard to run an adversarial review of the running UI against acceptance criteria.
